reason: I trust the creator and the bottle looks nice, but I already fill my bottle at the gym fountain and it works fine. Dropping $68 today plus a filter bill every few months is a lot on my budget for something I don't really need.
objection: I already have a bottle that works, and the filter plan turns a one-time buy into another subscription I have to remember to cancel.
would_change_my_mind: A bigger creator code that gets the bottle with one filter under $30, with no subscription needed.
